subject: Request: CedarPath pilot accelerator grant + term carveout
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpath.ai>, Michael Tan <m.tan@procurecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: CedarPath pilot — ask for pilot boost + term carveout

Hi Elena / Michael,

Great conversation earlier — thanks for the candid feedback on the POC scope. Based on your success criteria (low-latency inference at 99th percentile < 250ms and sample-set-quality > 92%), CedarPath is asking for two things that are outside our standard commercial pack for pilots: a 60-day trial extension and an additional usage credit to cover model eval spikes during integration.

Quick summary of the ask: 
- 60-day extension to the pilot (current end date: 2026-12-01)
- $45,000 one-time usage credit applied to the pilot (to support evaluation workloads)
- Minor SLA tweak: temporary 99.9% availability target for dedicated test pool (for the duration of pilot)

What CedarPath is committing in return:
- 12-month post-pilot commit of $200k ARR (standard legal T&Cs)
- Reference agreement clause for a joint case study if pilot success criteria met

Marissa / Aditya / Grace — I need an exception approval to provide the combined credits + extension + short-term SLA carveout. This will be an executive approval because the total concession (credits + rate change risk) exceeds my quota-level delegation.

Attachments: CedarPath_Pilot_SOW-v2.docx (SOW draft), Procurement_Checklist.pdf

Next step: if you can give me a quick thumbs up (or counter) today, I’ll share a redlined SOW and an updated HubSpot deal with the new economics.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpath.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPath pilot — ask for pilot boost + term carveout

Priyom — thanks for the concise summary. I agree CedarPath is strategic for our healthcare vertical play and the reference value is high. Two thoughts:

1) Credits: $45k is larger than our standard pilot uplift. My comfort range without exec sign-off is $20k-$30k.
2) SLA carveout: temporary 99.9% availability for a dedicated test pool is operationally feasible but we need SRE confirmation (Dev, can you validate risk and ops cost?)

Aditya — can you approve an exception for the combined ask (60-day extension + $45k credit + SLA carveout)? If full approval is tough, can we offer a split: $30k credit + 30-day extension + conditional SLA guarantee tied to a limited test pool?

If Aditya approves, Finance will need an internal memo and Legal will need a brief amendment to the master services agreement. I’ve added the SOW draft to the thread.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpath.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPath pilot — ask for pilot boost + term carveout

Quick ops readout:
- We can provision a small dedicated test pool on a single region (us-west-2) and commit to a scoped 99.9% availability SLA for the pilot period. That will require a temporary standby node and slight manual runbook — estimated incremental cost to us is ~$2,500/week while the pool is up.
- The higher credit mainly covers integration churn (re-indexing, eval bursts). If finance approves credit, we can also enable prefix KV caching to keep token costs down during evaluation.

Recommendation: approve a larger credit only if there is a written post-pilot commit (CP-2026-119) and signature within 30 days of pilot close.

-Dev

--
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cedarpath.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tan <m.tan@procurecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPath pilot — ask for pilot boost + term carveout

Hi Priyom/Marissa,

Thanks — quick update from our side. Procurement is comfortable with the downstream commit but they need the extended window to complete SOC review and API integration tests. We’d accept a conditional approval: if Redwood provides $45k in pilot credits and a 60-day extension, we will sign the 12-month commitment at $200k ARR within 30 days of the extended pilot end.

If there’s an alternative structure (smaller credit + accelerated signature), we can consider that too but the SOC cycle is the gating factor.

Best,
Elena

Elena Ruiz
Head of Integrations, CedarPath AI
elena.ruiz@cedarpath.ai

Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPath pilot — ask for pilot boost + term carveout

Folks — thanks for the context. I reviewed the SOW and the deal economics in HubSpot. CedarPath is a high-priority logo for our healthcare/ML vectorization case studies, and the risk is manageable with the conditions Dev outlined. I approve the following exception: 

- $40,000 one-time pilot credit (to be applied to pilot invoices)
- 45-day pilot extension (not full 60 days)
- Scoped 99.9% availability for a single dedicated test pool in us-west-2 (ops runbook required)
- Legal to add a signature-trigger clause: CedarPath must sign the 12-month $200k ARR agreement within 30 days of the extended pilot end, otherwise unused credit is forfeited and future concessions must be renegotiated.

Marissa / Priyom — proceed with a redline that captures the above and route to Legal + Finance. Priyom, offer CedarPath the approved package; if they push hard for the full $45k + 60 days, escalate back to me with a clear delta and justification.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
